newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonian stocks ease but expected to hold.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonian stocks ease but expected to hold.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Thursday was mixed with gains in the morning falling off in the afternoon, dealers said.
However, they expected the market to hold steady amid some slight selling pressure.
Total volume on the official list was 81.8 million kroons and the index lost 1.99 percent to close on 260.43.
"Some small selling is expected to stay tomorrow but prices are expected to hold as investors wait for the banking sector's results," one trader said.
Uhispank was the most active stock on volatile trade during the day. It ended just 0.90 kroons down to close on 61.90 kroons on turnover of 32.2 million kroons.
"This swing shows the volitity of the market, with dealers not knowing which way to call the trend," he added.

Forekspank also saw strong trade with 21.5 million kroons of shares traded to close 0.85 kroons higher on 194.60 kroons. Foreskpank earlier released its first quarter profit results which showed a net profit of 28.99 million kroons.
"The results look good, but most of the profit is still from securities trading in January and February and not normal banking operations, so they may not keep this up," another trader said.
Hansapank lost 5.00 kroons to close on 260.00 after 12.5 million kroons of shares changed hands.
On the free market, total trade was 12 million kroons of shares, with diversified industrialist Norma still the most active stock although it lost ground after a sharp rise.
Norma lost 4.35 kroons to end on 77.00 kroons with a turnover of 3.5 million kroons of shares. The earlier rise came after it increased its first-half profit forecast.
"Although Norma's results were good, it seems that investors over-reacted and an adjustment was made but it should hold around this level," one dealer said.
Rakvere meat plant was steady on 15.80 kroons with 2.9 million kroons of shares changing hands.
